typography.description: Cormorant Garamond provides a high-end, classic financial advisory feel, while Outfit keeps the body text highly readable, modern, and clean.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4F6F57] text-white hover:bg-[#3F5C49] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#EAF1EB] text-[#4F6F57] hover:bg-[#C9C9C9]/30 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors border border-transparent
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#4F6F57] text-[#4F6F57] hover:bg-[#EAF1EB] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

layout_and_spacing.grids: Use 12-column bento grids for outcome cards and stats to create visual tension and premium feel. Avoid symmetrical 50/50 splits where possible.

motion.entrance: Fade up with Framer Motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1])
motion.hover: Subtle y-axis translation for cards (-translate-y-1) and image zoom on hover.

images.description: Black bicycle leaning on metal fence by Amsterdam canal, perfect for contextual Dutch real estate vibes.
Amsterdam canal houses under white sky.
Modern minimalist living room with large window, showing potential property value.
Black and brown leather sofa in a modern minimalist setting.
Person analyzing documents with a laptop, represents the validation and scanning process.
Professional in suit holding a tablet, representing the advisory role.

sections.name: Header & Nav
sections.direction: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Must include language switcher (NL/EN) and a primary CTA 'Validate Property' in #4F6F57. Logo left, nav center, CTA right.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.direction: Split composition or layered look. Dark charcoal background (#171717) base, blending into white. Use the Amsterdam canal house image overlaid with a sage green accent block. Headline: 'Validate before you invest.' Dual CTAs: Primary €99 Quick-Scan, Secondary €750 Investment Plan. Text in white/light grey.

sections.name: Problem Section
sections.direction: White background (#FFFFFF). High whitespace. Left-aligned typography. Explain Dutch real estate regulations (WWS, Box 3). Use subtle green borders on text blocks to anchor them.

sections.name: Guidance Gap
sections.direction: Light green background (#EAF1EB). Asymmetric layout highlighting the gap: Brokers sell, Banks lend, Nobody validates. Use the professional holding tablet image here. Dark green text (#3F5C49).

sections.name: Solution / 4 Outcomes
sections.direction: White background. 4 cards in a bento grid (e.g., Buy, Negotiate, Improve, Walk away). Rounded corners (16px), subtle shadows. Icons in silver/grey (#C9C9C9).

sections.name: Product Features
sections.direction: Dark background (#111111) to create contrast. Fidaro Investment Plan features. White text. Use the document analysis image here with a max overlay of bg-black/40. Features displayed as a clean checklist.

sections.name: Quick-Scan MVP
sections.direction: White background. Focus on the €99 Quick-Scan. Showcase feature checklist with green checkmarks (#4F6F57).

sections.name: Market Validation Stats
sections.direction: Minimalist stat grid (67%, 88%, 51 responses). Massive typography for the numbers (text-6xl+ Cormorant Garamond). Off-white or subtle silver background (#C9C9C9 at 10% opacity).

sections.name: Comparison Table
sections.direction: Brokers vs Platforms vs Fidaro. Clean borders, plenty of padding (p-6 per cell). Highlight Fidaro's column with a faint green background (#EAF1EB) and dark green border.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.direction: 2 Pricing cards. €99 (Stripe checkout) and €750. Make the €99 card visually prominent (perhaps with a top border of #4F6F57). Rounded 2xl cards, shadow-sm.

sections.name: Process Steps
sections.direction: 4 steps timeline. Vertical line connecting nodes in silver (#C9C9C9), active/step nodes in sage green (#4F6F57).

sections.name: FAQ
sections.direction: Accordion component (Shadcn customized). Clean lines, 1px bottom border for each question. No background on items, just white.

sections.name: Contact Form
sections.direction: Dark charcoal section (#171717). White/silver inputs with rounded-xl corners. 1px border of #3F5C49. Button in primary green.

sections.name: Footer
sections.direction: Dark background. Minimalist. Links for Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer. Monochromatic logo variant if possible, or standard logo.

accessibility.contrast_standards: APCA over WCAG 2, ensure #4F6F57 on white is readable, and white text on #4F6F57.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or any generic sans-serif for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for a premium advisory feel.
Apply data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Do NOT use violet or purple gradients anywhere.
Images MUST be used from the provided URLs, no placeholder domains.
Maintain high contrast and professional aesthetics as defined by Archetype 1 + 5.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons, styling them in #4F6F57 or #C9C9C9 as needed.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on scroll.
